variants.headline: The bag that gets passed round the office
variants.body: Baked red lentil crisps made for sharing. Fair warning: it won't come back.
variants.rationale: Social proof: frames the crisp as something groups already share, with no invented numbers.

variants.headline: Don't wait for the last bag
variants.body: Baked red lentil crisps from Yorkshire. When the shelf's empty, it's empty.
variants.rationale: Scarcity: urgency from limited shelf stock, without claiming a fake limited run.

variants.headline: 13g protein. Still a crisp.
variants.body: Baked, not fried, from red lentils. The crunch you want, with protein on the label.
variants.rationale: Health halo: leads with the protein and baked-not-fried facts.

variants.headline: Proper crunch. Proper salt.
variants.body: Sea salt lentil crisps for the 4pm slump. No apology needed.
variants.rationale: Indulgence: pleasure and permission, no health framing.

variants.headline: Made in Yorkshire
variants.body: Red lentils and sea salt, baked not fried, made in Yorkshire.
variants.rationale: Provenance: origin and simple ingredients as the reason to trust it.

variants.headline: £1.80 for a proper 85g bag
variants.body: A full-size bag of baked lentil crisps for less than your coffee.
variants.rationale: Value: price and pack size up front.
